communication_goal: 明确优先事项、期限和下一步。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone finished educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure white background, clean consistent black line art, minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces and thin limbs, restrained polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No color, no gradients, no shading, no photographic rendering. One coherent scene, no panels. Keep all people and props in the central area approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on a 0..1000 canvas. Preserve generous empty white space at top (y<180), bottom (y>850), and sides for learning labels added later. Make the named learning props clearly recognizable and fully visible. Gestures should show a conversation. No speech balloons, captions, logos, watermarks, readable code, or long text; simple abstract UI marks are allowed. Scene: Two adult stick-figure developers standing on opposite sides of one central freestanding task board. The board has three simple vertical columns and a few blank square task cards; one colleague points to the top card while the other holds a small pen and nods. The whole task board including its rectangular frame is clearly visible, unobstructed, centrally placed. No readable writing or numbers on cards. Minimal office setting, no other props.
